item.tib: rtogs 'joms dbal chen wer spungs kyi gzhung
item.coloph: ces dbal tshogs sum brgya drug cu las gzhung sogs 'di/ lo rgyus ni dang po zhang zhung stag sna rgyal po'i sku srung du/ gyer spungs khri ldem lcags kyi bya ru can gyis mdzad/ de nas snang bzher lod po la brgyud nas mi lo bcu gsum la bka' rgya byas nas/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha' la brgyud/ bla chen gyis 'di nub nas zhang zhung dza rgyud kun nub par dgongs nas/ dang ra'i mtsho la brag ru sbal 'dra ba'i logs su sbas/ phyis dus bon zhig blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis yos lo'i rgun zla 'bring po'i tshes bco lnga la gter zhal phyes nas/ ba yo mtshams pa la brgyad/ des nas rme'u g.yung drung rgyal po dang rog btang sogs la brgyud/ des shes rab rgyal mtshan la/ des rin chen rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ des tshul khrims rgyal mtshan la brgyud/ rme'u bsod nams ye shes nas gcig rgyud du dar ba lags so/ dgra bgegs 'dul ba dang khyim grib srung ba dang*/ lha 'dre'i za kha bzlog pa dang chung sri 'dul ba dang / dme nal yug gsum zhi bar 'gyur/ phyi ma dbal tshogs sprul ba'i zhal mthong bar 'gyur ro//
